item.title: [7.0] Is Forgetting Unified? Exploring Concept Unlearning in Unified Multimodal Models
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Unified multimodal models (UMMs) integrate image generation and visual understanding, but are existing single-pathway unlearning methods sufficient to suppress target concepts across both? In this work, we study cross-pathway concept unlearning. Our goal is to prevent a model from both generating images of a target concept and identifying it in input images, while preserving other capabilities.

WHY IT MATTERS

This paper addresses an emerging challenge in safety and alignment for unified multimodal models by introducing a benchmark and method for cross-pathway concept unlearning.

item.title: [7.0] YANAMI: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset and Benchmark for Multiturn Stateful Interaction
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) integrate visual understanding, generation, and editing within a single unified framework. However, existing unified multimodal datasets and benchmarks remain dominated by single-turn tasks. Even in recent multi-turn datasets, many turns can be solved independently without tracking information across turns.

WHY IT MATTERS

YANAMI addresses a notable gap in multimodal AI by introducing a large-scale dataset and benchmark specifically designed for multi-turn stateful interactions rather than single-turn tasks.
